lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce8Si4Te4 (Ce2SiTe) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ce centers surrounded by eight neighbors (4 Si, 4 Te), while Si and Te each have nine geometric neighbors, with Si coordinated by 4 Ce and 5 Te. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Ce and Si polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ce polyhedra.
